summary: Rishabh Jain is a serial entrepreneur and educator based in Jaipur, India, with a background in Civil Engineering from IIT Bombay. He has founded 9 ventures over 15 years, with current focus on AI-led founder communities (APEs) and a massive personal finance/law YouTube channel (LLA). His public persona blends high-level business strategy with community building, storytelling, and a strong emphasis on mentorship for early-stage founders.
